Hi Amelia — Diego here on the PLG outreach team, thanks for signing up and for the note. Quick q: what timezone are you in? You indicated Sunday mornings PST would work — that helps.

We typically offer two formats: a 20-minute "quickwalk" (high-level + live sandbox), or a 45-minute deep-dive (architecture + integration tips). Either works; for a sandbox-first approach I recommend the 20-min quickwalk so you can start poking at the API during the call.

Here are three slots I can offer this weekend (all PST):
- Sun 11/21 10:00 AM
- Sun 11/21 11:00 AM
- Mon 11/22 09:00 AM

If none of those fit, tell me two windows that work and we can accommodate.

I'll also provision a short-lived sandbox token if you'd like to try before the call — can confirm once you pick a slot. Pre-call checklist (optional): 1) quick account signup at https://app.redwood.ai/signup, 2) sample prompt set you want us to test (paste into reply), 3) timezone.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
